widgets_values:
**Prefix（制作前缀）**
Style: 5‑second vertical 9:16, oriental uncanny eerie atmosphere, cinematic realism blended with delicate illustration texture, dim night low‑saturation tone, warm lantern glow contrasting against cool‑blue night mist; ancient fox‑spirit theme maintained, no cartoon stylization, no modern‑style scenes.
Reference: Use Reference Image 1 as first‑frame and main subject reference, lock the fox‑spirit’s orange‑red robe, white fur collar, bamboo pole lantern, ancient bridge and forest stone‑path atmosphere. Pre‑transformation inherits fox‑spirit head, fox ears, fur color and uncanny aura. Post‑transformation becomes a young adult woman with distinct fox ears retained, preserving orange‑red outfit styling and lantern prop; no extra characters added.
Lighting Setup: Key light comes from warm‑yellow practical light of the lantern on right side; background consists of cool‑blue moonlight and low‑brightness mist. At transformation moment, lantern light sweeps across the face, creating warm‑light occlusion and brief highlight; light source direction stays stable, no random flickering.
Camera: Eye‑level to slightly low camera angle, overall steady camera movement. First follow the approaching figure, then slowly push toward the face, finally pull back slightly to show the back view. Shallow depth of field, subject stays centered at all times; background ancient bridge and tree shadows maintain depth of field, no abrupt scene cuts.
Audio: Ambient sounds including night wind, distant crickets, fabric rustle and soft lantern clinks. Low‑frequency eerie sound effect triggers at transformation moment; footsteps fade away toward the end. No dialogue, no voice‑over, no on‑screen text.

**Segment Task**
Generate a 5‑second image‑to‑video clip, execute only this continuous sequence: fox‑spirit walking forward → lantern‑light‑triggered mystical transformation → young adult woman with fox ears giving restrained bewitching gaze toward camera → turn around and walk away in back view. Prioritize seamless transformation, preserved fox ears, close‑up eye performance and lingering ending back‑view shot.
Duration: 5 seconds
Segment Function: Uncanny fox‑spirit appearance and seductive departure
Core Actions: walking, light‑occluded mystical transformation, close‑up gaze, turning and walking away
Do NOT develop extra plot, no second character, no location switching.

Shot 1 (00:00‑00:01.3) Fox‑spirit approaches carrying lantern
Camera Params: Medium‑full shot to medium shot, steady eye‑level follow shot with slight push‑in.
Visual Content: The fox‑spirit walks slowly along night stone path, bamboo pole rests across shoulders, lantern emits warm glow on right side of frame; ancient bridge and tree shadows loom faintly deep in background.
Actions & Changes: Slow paced footsteps; robe hem, fur collar and tail fur sway gently in night breeze; lantern sways softly; subject remains centered.
Audio & Rhythm: Slow build‑up; night‑wind ambience, crickets, soft lantern clinks and subtle footsteps.
Stability Requirement: Preserve fox‑spirit identity, orange‑red robe, white fur collar, bamboo lantern prop and night ancient‑bridge environment from reference image; no outfit swap, no scene change.

Shot 2 (00:01.3‑00:03.2) Mystical transformation under lantern light
Camera Params: Medium shot slowly push‑in to medium close‑up, shallow depth of field, subject face stays clear without over‑extreme close‑up.
Visual Content: Warm lantern light sweeps across fox‑spirit’s face, thin mist drifts across foreground, light and mist partially obscure half of the face.
Actions & Changes: Once obscuration fades, fox‑spirit mystically transforms into a young adult woman with clearly visible fox ears and uncanny eyes retained. Outfit keeps the styling of original orange‑red ancient robe and fur collar; lantern remains beside her. Transformation manifests as natural apparition within light, no explosive special effects.
Audio & Rhythm: Brief pause at transformation trigger point, low‑frequency eerie sound mixed with fabric rustle, then audio volume quickly drops.
Stability Requirement: Post‑transformation character must read as young adult woman, no juvenile appearance. Fox ears remain distinct, facial features stable, no facial drifting, no malformed extra limbs.

Shot 3 (00:03.2‑00:05.0) Fox‑eared woman gazes then departs
Camera Params: Hold close‑up for half a second, then slightly pull back to medium‑long shot, end frame features back view.
Visual Content: Young adult woman with fox ears leans slightly forward, casting restrained, dangerous, bewitching gaze toward camera with faint upward curve at mouth corner. She then turns and walks deep toward ancient bridge, her back figure fading amid cool‑blue night mist and warm lantern glow.
Actions & Changes: Eyes lock onto camera, hold briefly then turn away. Robe hem and hair flow with natural inertia; lantern light diminishes as she walks farther, ending with lingering composition of her back silhouette and distant glimmers.
Audio & Rhythm: Near‑silence for first half second, only faint breath sound. After turning, footsteps and wind ambience gradually recede; low‑frequency eerie sound fades out.
Stability Requirement: Keep fox ears, consistent identity of this young adult woman, original outfit color scheme and night stone‑path environment. Character walks away showing back view; no reversion to fox‑spirit head, no secondary transformation.
